text: FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE WELIGAMA URBAN COUNCIL UNDER SECTION 66A(1)(a) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of member of Weligama Urban Council has fallen vacant by reason of Death;

And whereas the Secretary of the Jathika Jana Balawegaya, the recognized political party to which Kaluthota Kuruwe Arachchige Manoj Udayakara the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(l)(a) of the aforesaid Ordinance, to decide upon the member of that Ward Number 04 Pelena West of Weligama Urban Council who belongs to such party and is not disqualified under Section 9 of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared elected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days;
And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision to nominate Marakkala Manage Inoka Damayanthi to fill such vacancy;

Therefore I, Pulasthi Serasingha Pathirana, Returning Officer of the Weligama Urban Council, acting in terms of Section 66A(l)(a) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that Marakkala Manage Inoka Damayanthi was elected as the member of the Ward Number 04, Pelena West of Weligama Urban Council.
P. S. Pathirana, Returning Officer, Weligama Urban Council.District Elections Office,Matara,29th of December, 2025.
